scientific-notation.def: A way of writing a number as a number from 1 to 10 times a power of ten, such as 2.5 × 10⁶ for 2,500,000.

metric-prefix.def: A word part in front of a metric unit that multiplies it by a power of ten: kilo (10³), mega (10⁶), giga (10⁹), centi (10⁻²), milli (10⁻³), micro (10⁻⁶).
